title: Head of Platform — midday catchup and action rail
content:
(Quick catchup, messy — personal notes)

Context: back-to-back mornings — FYI for myself and Lina. Goal: make progress on Dedicated capacity autoscale proposal and figure out next steps for on-prem onboarding blockers. Keep this lean — use as agenda for 3pm sync.

Top-line for today (3 things):
- Lock decision on autoscale burst headroom policy (cost vs reliability). Need commit from infra finance to model cost impact by EOD Friday.
- Unblock on-prem installer for customer X (TLS/KMS flow + audit exports). Escalate to SRE if not resolved by 5pm.
- Prep short brief for exec review on Tuesday (2 slides): status, risks, ask (headcount/contract).

Meetings to prep for / quick notes:
- 3:00pm — Platform leadership (Lina, Marc, me) — agenda: autoscale proposal, Dedicated capacity SLAs, hiring funnel.
  - Bring: short simulation numbers (see JIRA PLAT-2123), list of tradeoffs for burst capacity (latency percentiles vs. committed cost).
  - Ask Lina to surface 2 customer cases where burst mattered last quarter.
- 4:15pm — On-prem install postmortem w/ Solutions Eng (customer X) — goal: root cause + remediation timeline.
  - John to demo failing step (KMS handshake). If missing 1-2 configs we can patch via hotfix; if deeper, schedule maintenance window.
- 5:30pm — 1:1 with Marc — pipeline prioritization, candidate reference check (Eng Manager).

Action items (my immediate todo, check when done):
- [ ] Pull cost/sla simulation table for autoscale (inputs: utilization curves, burst multiplier) — use spreadsheet "Autoscale-sims-Mar2026" (GH/drive link in artifacts). Target: 2pm prep.
- [ ] Draft 2-slide exec brief for Tuesday; highlight 3 asks (budget, hiring, pilot customers). Rough bullets by EOD.
- [ ] Call SRE lead (Priya) if KMS handshake still failing after John's debug (target 4:45pm).
- [ ] Confirm dedicated infra contract renewal dates with Finance — note upcoming vendor negotiation window.
- [ ] Ping legal on updated SOC2 access pattern for private deployments (short note).

Week view (what I need to move forward this week):
- Autoscale: decision path, cost modeling, rollout plan (canary -> 25% -> 100%).
- On-prem installer: make the TLS/KMS handshake idempotent; add clearer error messages; add automated smoke test.
- Hiring: prioritize two IC backend hires and one infra manager for Q2 ramp.
- Observability: get per-route tail-latency histogram into console for top 10 customers (ask product-obs).

Open questions / blockers:
- Finance needs clear signal: what is acceptable latency tail tradeoff for 20% cost reduction? Who signs off?
- On-prem audit export — customer X wants daily bundle; our export tool currently supports weekly. Engineering change estimate? (ask Data Eng).
- Is there appetite to ship a minimal KMS shim for early customers vs full KMS integration? Risk: subtle key expiry edge cases.

Notes from this morning (raw):
- Slack with customer X at 08:12: "installer fails at step 4, error 502 on handshake". John is repro-ing locally.
- Lina flagged a customer complaint: spike in token cost due to poor batching config — product needs a default per-model profile. Add to Optimize backlog.
- Received PR from infra-engineering: "continuous-batching: reduce pad waste" — code looks OK, need perf test results before merging.

Decisions to make today (if possible):
- If autoscale can guarantee 95th latency <= target with <15% cost delta, we can pilot. Otherwise push to next quarter.
- If we can provide daily audit exports via scheduled job w/ modest infra work (<2 engineer-weeks), approve and include in onboarding checklist.

Outreach & follow-ups (people):
- Lina Park — ask for customer cases (ASAP) + ping on hiring screen.
- Marc Chen — confirm interview panel for infra manager candidate.
- John Rivera (solutions eng) — status on KMS repro by 3:30pm.
- Priya Singh (SRE) — potential on-call for emergency fix tonight if installer rollback required.
- Finance: Aisha — quick sync on vendor negotiation timing, cc legal.

Personal reminders (notes-to-self):
- Eat lunch (actually) — skipped breakfast, low energy affects decisions.
- Keep 20 min at 6pm for reflection & update this doc with outcomes.
- Send 1-paragraph update to CEO if we hit decision point today (no more than 5 bullets).

Elevator pitch / one-liner to use in exec brief:
"Autoscale burst gives customers reliable tails at manageable incremental spend — pilot with 3 enterprise customers, measure 95th latency and cost delta before wider rollout."

If time permits tonight:
- Draft short FAQ for Solutions Eng to use for on-prem installs (common failures + quick fixes).
- Run quick call with data-eng about daily audit export feasibility.

End of midday catchup. Will update after 3pm sync.
